responsibility: Declares default-channel decimal whole-number I/O for SHORTINT and SHORTCARD values. It mirrors ShortWholeIO’s channel-based interface while binding operations to the current standard channels, giving callers ISO convenience procedures for short whole-number input and output.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the SShortWholeIO pair: it declares the default-channel SHORTINT/SHORTCARD procedures visible to clients, whereas SShortWholeIO.mod supplies those procedures by forwarding to ShortWholeIO and StdChans.
